checks.label: Hosted API outage/error handling
checks.evidence: On Google Pixel 10 Pro Android 16, Codex installed internal Android preview build d90e9595-56f1-49a7-8348-6541fa500edb after temporarily setting EAS preview EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to https://invalid.reversr.invalid. Check your internet connection and try again." Device network settings and the production API were not changed. Screenshots: /tmp/reversr-native-artifacts/android-invalid-api-settings.png and /tmp/reversr-native-artifacts/android-invalid-api-network-error.png.
